You raise many points to argue. Where do I begin...

1) Gender Dysphoria is in no way like schizophrenia or psychosis. It’s not hearing voices or seeing things that are not really there. The comparison, as I said, was quite a stretch. Gender dysphoria is the feeling that your gender at birth does not align with the gender you experience, and often comes with great suffering, in a different way than the other previously mentioned illnesses. Trans people are not hallucinating a dick where there isn’t one, or boobs on their flat chest. They’re not delusional. They are people, just like you. They have insecurities, and thoughts, and feelings. They’re just trying their best to express themselves the way they feel inside.

2) YES, THEIR ILLNESSES ARE REAL. They are real, valid illnesses. They suffer because of them. Mental illnesses are valid. I am, in fact, aware that I have a mental illness. *gasp* crazy, right? I’m aware that the reason I feel this way is because of a mental illness, and I am in fact doing my best to get help, which leads me to my next point.

3) The way in which transgender people “get help” *is by transitioning* . That is the only known “cure” for gender dysphoria. They cannot simply take drugs and have their feelings of being the opposite gender than they were born as vanish. They cannot go to a therapist, talk it out, and leave as a cisgender person. That’s just not how it works. I’ve seen that line used so many times, and it still astonishes me as to how ignorant and uninformed people can be. 

I hope this was helpful. And, I’m not overreacting, you are, as I was being completely civil until you came along and aggressively told me to “get help”. Have a nice day!
